summary.text: This resolution expresses support for the designation of a National Day of Awareness for Missing and Murdered Indigenous Women and Girls.

title: Expressing support for the designation of May 5, 2025, as the "National Day of Awareness for Missing and Murdered Indigenous Women and Girls".
